description: Driver params: refused values and accepted forms.

vectors.description: Defaults.
The documented defaults, spelled out.
iQ-R is accepted (it changes the frame, not the plan).
UDP is accepted.
0 and 1 are accepted for first_word_low.
null means default.
Unknown keys are ignored.
Header route numbers.
max_words at its minimum.

invalid.a: melsec address 'D0' (float32): needs 2 words in one request, more than max_words=1 (MC 3E limit 960)

vectors.description: An unknown plc_type. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param plc_type='A': expected one of ('Q', 'L', 'QnA', 'iQ-L', 'iQ-R')

vectors.description: A number for plc_type. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param plc_type=5: expected one of ('Q', 'L', 'QnA', 'iQ-L', 'iQ-R')

vectors.description: An unknown protocol. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param protocol='serial': expected one of ('tcp', 'udp')

vectors.description: 4E frames are not supported. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param frame='4E': expected one of ('3E',)

vectors.description: max_words above the 3E limit. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param max_words=961: expected an integer 1..960

vectors.description: max_words below 1. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param max_words=0: expected an integer 1..960

vectors.description: A bool is not an integer. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param max_words=True: expected an integer 1..960

vectors.description: A float is not an integer. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param max_words=10.5: expected an integer 1..960

vectors.description: Text is not an integer. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param max_words='10': expected an integer 1..960

vectors.description: A negative max_gap. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param max_gap=-1: expected an integer 0..1000000

vectors.description: Text for a boolean. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param first_word_low='yes': expected true or false

vectors.description: Only 0 and 1 stand for a boolean. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param first_word_low=2: expected true or false

vectors.description: An unknown nonnormal_float. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param nonnormal_float='nan': expected one of ('zero', 'unmodified')

vectors.description: network above 255. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param network=256: expected an integer 0..255

vectors.description: pc below 0. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param pc=-1: expected an integer 0..255

vectors.description: dest_moduleio above 0xFFFF. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param dest_moduleio=65536: expected an integer 0..65535

vectors.description: dest_modulesta above 255. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param dest_modulesta=256: expected an integer 0..255

vectors.description: plc_type is checked before frame. The driver is refused.

expected.error: melsec_mc param plc_type='A': expected one of ('Q', 'L', 'QnA', 'iQ-L', 'iQ-R')
